# `TuningNavItem`

Helper: `card({ comp: 'TuningNavItem', title, v, tint }, sm(sub))`  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap (`TuningNav` item: `Card` list, active one tinted) · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): none

## Anatomy

A `card` (`comp: 'TuningNavItem'`) that holds one of the six groups of "Mô hình & cấu hình"; the active one is `v: soft`, `tint: info`.

## Variants

- As listed in the rules of BLOCKS.md

## States

- Active: soft card, info tint
- Inactive: plain card

## Tokens

card tokens + the tokens of its badges, buttons and fields

## Do

- Mark the active group visibly

## Don't

- Do not draw it with new markup; compose it from card, badge, button, field

## Web (1440 and 1920)

A card in the frame grid.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.
